response.overview: "Location Guide" is a featurette originally released in the 2007 DVD set, Twin Peaks: Definitive Gold Box Edition. It was later re-released in the Blu-ray sets, Twin Peaks: The Entire Mystery and Twin Peaks: From Z to A.  As the title states, it is a guide to finding the real-life filming locations seen in Twin Peaks and Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me.
response.title: Location Guide
